brief:
An Israeli drone strike killed two Palestinians in Deir al-Balah early Monday morning, according to medical sources cited by Anadolu Agency. The strike struck an area in central Gaza where displaced residents had gathered, part of the territory's ongoing humanitarian crisis as fighting continues across the enclave.

Medical personnel at local facilities confirmed the identities of the two killed, though their names were not immediately released in initial reports. The strike added to the mounting civilian toll in Gaza's central region, where displacement camps and shelters have become frequent targets during the conflict.

title: Israeli drone strike kills two Palestinians in central Gaza
